design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (rental_property_renewals_and_cancellations, M=2). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5, 6, 4, 5]. Assignment (round 2): catch-up charge 5, late-renewal premium 6, returned-payment fee 5, Plus upgrade charge 4.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The caller (Philippa Oyelaran-Marchetti) asks only to move her Wexmoor Lane rental contract up to Combo Plus. The agent must discover from the policies and the records that (a) the contract is not in a current term (term ended 2026-09-30; the renewal notice of 2026-08-28 came only 33 days before term end, so the contract expired instead of auto-renewing), (b) the tier upgrade of 2026-05-12 never received its upgrade charge, and (c) the 2025-10-09 returned check payment 31570655 was billed back without its fee. Four synchronous writes follow in a forced order, each with its own multi-factor calculation over the ledger, claims, requests and two other products (utility line plan, homeowner plan).

2. SCOPE. Claimed: landlord_ext_upgrade_catchup_charge, landlord_ext_late_renewal_premium, landlord_ext_returned_payment_fee, landlord_ext_plus_upgrade_charge; tools bill_upgrade_catchup_f812c6ed, record_late_renewal_5b858282, bill_returned_payment_fee_d229d74e, accept_plus_upgrade_7955ec7e. Task 1 holds the four cancellation-side policies and tools; scopes are disjoint and cover all eight.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root landlord_ext_plus_upgrade_charge (owner=user accept_plus_upgrade_7955ec7e: accepting an upgrade price is the landlord's decision). Edges, all state form:
 - Plus <- late renewal, value_input (remaining_days): "An upgrade charge is worked out only once the contract stands in a current term, in its waiting period or active, whose annual premium is billed on the contract." False: status expired, term end 2026-09-30. For an expired contract only the late-renewal write restores a current term with its annual premium. Skip run: 100.45 -> -9.95.
 - Plus <- catch-up, value_input (upgrade_charges_12u): "An upgrade charge is fixed only after every earlier tier upgrade on the contract carries its own upgrade charge." False: plan change 2026-05-12, no upgrade charge. For an annual contract only the catch-up policy bills it (the upgrade-difference policy is monthly-only). Skip: 100.45 -> 109.28.
 - Plus <- fee, state_gate: "No upgrade charge is fixed until the most recent returned payment on the contract carries its returned-payment fee." False: returned payment 31570655 has no fee. Skip: value unchanged (100.45); the fee row is missing.
 - late renewal <- catch-up, value_input (expired_term_premium): "The late-renewal premium is fixed only after every tier upgrade made during the expired term carries its upgrade charge on the contract." Skip: 705.92 -> 746.65 (claims loading 0.06 -> 0.12).
 - fee <- late renewal, state_gate: "A returned-payment fee is not billed until the contract stands in force again, in a status under which premium is billed." Skip: the fee would be billed on an expired contract.
 Each sentence joins this policy's result to a record-visible state with an ordering connective, names no tool, id or code token, and is exactly as strong as its edge; directions are mixed. value_input edges 3 >= 2. Order unique: catch-up -> late renewal -> fee -> Plus upgrade.

4. FACTOR CARD (handling-time values).
 Catch-up 37.21 (all-baseline 67.38): covered_share_convention (method) end date on file -> whole months 4/12 (43.12); billing_delay_concession 155 days -> 0.25 (51.74); homeowner_plan_concession (cross homeplan) Gold, monthly -> 0.03 (38.95); catchup_autopay_concession (multi-source) latest payment ACH, no return in 12 months -> 0.03 (38.95); term_count_goodwill three annual premiums -> 0.05 (40.12).
 Late renewal 705.92 (all-baseline 666.8): returned_history_pif_rate 2 returns -> 0.05 (668.77); claims_experience_loading (multi-source) 516.00 vs 529.59 -> 0.06 (665.2; near-miss 2025-09-24 authorization outside); request_frequency_loading 4 -> 0.05 (671.99); tenure_credit 1,109 days -> 0.04 (733.08); line_plan_bundle_credit (cross lineplan, multi-source) 11 payments -> 0.03 (726.29; near-miss 2025-10-10 payment outside); lapse_day_credit (method) late notice + auto-renew on -> actual-day convention (365-13)/365 (732.0); its second tier is the whole-week convention (52 less whole weeks)/52, a different day count.
 Returned fee 20.0 (all-baseline 25.0): repeat_return_level 2 -> 35.00 (15.0); returned_size_basis (method) 492.38 -> flat basis level + 5.00 (17.5; its top tier is a 2.5 percent basis); returned_channel_addition check -> 5.00 (17.5); portfolio_courtesy rate 0.05 -> 5.00 (22.5; base sentence on fees declared as a scoped overwrite); fee_ageing_reduction 12 months -> 0.50 (40.0). Near-miss: the 2024-10-07 returned-payment fee row is a fee, not a third return.
 Plus upgrade 100.45 (all-baseline 122.78): repeat_change_share (method, multi-source) one upgrade charge, no authorization in 3 months -> 11/12 (109.28); term_timing_adjustment day 0 -> credit 0.05 (106.09); plus_line_bundle_credit (cross lineplan) -> 0.03 (103.83); plus_autopay_credit -> 0.03 (103.83).
 Every ladder's tiers are reachable record states; no tier reads a stamp naming its outcome.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Late renewal: landlord_renewal_terms.late_renewal_in_grace, anchor term end 2026-09-30, 30 calendar days from 2026-10-01, boundary included (2026-10-14 is day 14; 2026-10-30 last qualifying day). Plus upgrade: landlord_plan_upgrade_rules.upgrade_on_open_contract, Rental Combo allows mid-term upgrades and the status is active after the late renewal. Premium charges: the open-status billing sentence is superseded only for catch-up charges on ended terms (declared overwrite); the fee and the upgrade charge are billed while active. Portfolio: the late renewal carries the expired term's recorded rate 0.05 (declared overwrite); the fee's portfolio courtesy departs from the base exclusion of fees from the portfolio discount and is declared as a scoped overwrite.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target contract 08d55af6-d580-4f10-adf7-0d2205d930f0 on 4418 Wexmoor Lane (2290 Brantley Court and 75 Orchard Hill Road ended 2026-03-31 and 2026-06-30 and are excluded; they explain the 0.05 band at past term starts). The catch-up charge belongs to the 2026-05-12 plan change; the fee belongs to payment 31570655 (31570311 already has its fee). Claims aggregates include only this contract's rows; the line plan and homeowner plan are read only.

7. WORLD ROWS. Customer; 3 landlord contracts; Wexmoor billing: 3 annual premiums 492.38 at 0.05, payments (2025-10-01 check 31570655 returned 2025-10-09 and re-paid by ACH 2025-10-15 as 31570702; 2024-10-01 ACH 31570311 returned 2024-10-07 with fee and re-paid by card), 5 service fees; opening balance 0.00. 5 service requests with determinations and authorizations; line plan with 13 charges and 12 payments; homeowner Gold. Final balance after gold 863.58. No automatic clause fires: the contract is already expired, the line plan's October premium is within grace.

8. PERSONA. Brisk landlord, opens with the upgrade only; phone 9375550143 and ZIP 45429 on request (card 3817 or email as fallback); passive consents for renewal, the earlier charge and the fee are triggered only by the representative's explanation; she remembers the bounced check only when the fee is mentioned; she runs the upgrade acceptance with the values read out; no payment is taken; she closes when told the contract is on Combo Plus.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> read contracts, billing, requests, claims, homeplan, line plan and its billing -> catch-up 37.21 at rate 0.05 -> late renewal 705.92 at rate 0.05 -> fee 20.0 for 31570655 -> hand over the Plus upgrade 100.45 at rate 0.05 (Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus).

10. VERIFICATION. Scratch evaluator replays gold through the real tools and evaluates each compute on its handling-time world, with per-factor and all-baseline substitutions and skip runs {'La<-Ga': 746.65, 'Ua<-La': 0.0, 'Ua<-Ga': 109.28, 'Ua<-F': 100.45, 'F<-La': 20.0}.

11. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The upgrade rule's prerequisite sentences send the agent to the contract status and to the billing history; the late-renewal and fee rules fix the order; the four calculations use only lookup results and persona lines. Agrees with gold.

REVISIONS. r1: initial design. r2 (policy audit round 1): fee portfolio courtesy declared against the base fee exclusion (G1); lapse credit rebuilt as an actual-day versus whole-week convention (G3); catch-up coverage-use loading and Plus upgrade tenant, emergency and unpaid-premium loadings removed in favour of autopay, term-count and line-plan bundle credits (G6 d/e/f); catch-up scope restricted to annual-billed contracts and its billing date aligned with the tool (O-1, O-6); Plus upgrade waiting-period status aligned with the base (O-9); prerequisite conditions made general (O-7); line-plan payments counted across the landlord's line plans as the rule says (O-3); the 2025-10-01 payment recorded as a check re-paid by ACH; the fee basis made a percentage-versus-flat method and ageing a parameter. r3 (policy audit round 2): the Plus upgrade's middle repeat-change tier now counts whole months down (no plus one), so it no longer coincides with the whole-term tier on an early upgrade (T0-O1); the Plus upgrade's fee gate names the most recent returned payment, the one the fee policy covers (fee-coverage gap). r4 (render notes and revision-3 observations): the fee's channel addition reads 10.00 for a payment made by card, exactly the condition the calculation tests; the fee's portfolio courtesy reads the contract's recorded portfolio rate, the most recent annual premium charge for an annual-billed contract and the installment for the current term's first period for a monthly-billed one (O-13); on this annual contract the courtesy is read from the new term's annual premium charge as before. Scored values are unchanged by r4. r5 (KB audit note): the fee's percentage basis for a returned payment of 1000.00 or more is now carried unrounded and the fee is rounded to the cent once at the end, as the rule states; the calculation, the rule and the ladder wording now agree, and every other policy already rounds only its final result. This world's returned payment falls in the flat-basis band, so no value moves. All values above are from the round-3 recomputation, re-verified in rounds 4 and 5.
user_scenario:
You are Philippa Oyelaran-Marchetti, a landlord in Dayton, Ohio, who owns a single-family rental house at 4418 Wexmoor Lane and keeps it under a Bridgewell rental property service contract. You are organised and brisk, calling on a weekday morning between errands, and you talk in short, practical sentences. In the spring your tenant's washer quit and Bridgewell turned the claim down because your plan does not cover laundry appliances, so you have decided to move the Wexmoor Lane contract up to Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus, which covers the laundry appliances and the garage door opener. You open by saying: "I'd like to upgrade the rental contract on 4418 Wexmoor Lane to Combo Plus." You want the upgrade done on this call; you are happy for the representative to take care of whatever has to be done on Bridgewell's side, and you will accept the upgrade price yourself when it is put in front of you.
When the representative asks how to find your account, you give your phone number, 9375550143. When they ask you to confirm your identity, you give the ZIP code of your mailing address, 45429; if they need one more detail you give the last four digits of the card on file, 3817, or your email address, philippa.oyelaran.marchetti@wexmoorrentals.net. You do not know the contract number by heart and say it should be on your account. If asked about the property, it is a single-family house built in 1952 and your tenant still lives there.
If the representative tells you the contract is no longer in force and has to be renewed, you are surprised, because you thought it renewed on its own, but you say: "Go ahead and renew it, I don't want the house without coverage." If the representative tells you that an earlier change to your plan was never billed, you confirm that you moved the plan up to Combo in May and say: "If that charge never went through, go ahead and put it on." If the representative mentions a fee connected with a payment that came back, you remember that the check you mailed for last October's premium bounced and that you paid it again online straight from your bank account, and you say: "If that fee is still owed, it can go on the account." You do not offer to pay anything today; if the representative asks how you will settle the balance, you say you will handle it through your online account and need nothing else set up on this call.
When the representative hands the upgrade to you and reads out what to enter, you accept it exactly as they give it to you, entering the contract number, the tier, the amount and the discount rate they read out, and you do not change any of them. You never suggest figures of your own. Once the representative confirms that the contract is now on Combo Plus, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Bill the never-billed upgrade charge for the 2026-05-12 move from Rental Systems to Rental Combo as one upgrade proration charge of 37.21, raising the premium balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The late-renewal premium is fixed only after every tier upgrade made during the expired term carries its upgrade charge, and the Plus upgrade charge is fixed only after every earlier upgrade carries its own charge; the catch-up policy computes the amount.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.landlord_contract_id: 08d55af6-d580-4f10-adf7-0d2205d930f0. Basis: the rental contract lookup returns this contract number for 4418 Wexmoor Lane, the property the caller names ("I'd like to upgrade the rental contract on 4418 Wexmoor Lane to Combo Plus."). Uniqueness: the other two contracts are on 2290 Brantley Court and 75 Orchard Hill Road and carry no recorded plan change.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.catchup_amount: 37.21. Annual tier difference 12 x (64.99 - 47.99) x (1 - 0.10) x (1 - 0.05) = 174.42 (term rate 0.05 on the 2025-10-01 annual premium). Covered share: the contract shows end date 2026-09-30, so whole months from 2026-05-12 to 2026-09-30 = 4, share 4/12 (not the standard 141/365). Adjustment 1 - 0.25 (155 days between upgrade and billing, more than 120) - 0.03 (active homeowner contract billed monthly) - 0.03 (most recent premium payment 2025-10-15 by ACH, no returned payment in the last twelve months; the 2025-10-09 return is twelve whole months back) - 0.05 (annual premium charges for three terms) = 0.64. 174.42 x 4/12 x 0.64 = 37.21.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.portfolio_discount_rate: 0.05. Basis: catch-up rule "reduced first by the tier's pay-in-full discount rate and then by the portfolio discount rate recorded on the term's annual premium charge"; the 2025-10-01 annual premium entry records 0.05. Uniqueness: it is the only annual premium charge of the term in which the upgrade was made.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the late-renewal tool named by the late-renewal premium policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Renew the expired Wexmoor Lane contract late: status active, new term 2026-10-14 to 2027-10-13, term number 4, annual premium 705.92 billed at the carried rate 0.05.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The Plus upgrade charge is worked out only once the contract stands active in a current term whose annual premium is billed; the caller agreed to the renewal; the late-renewal premium policy computes the premium.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.landlord_contract_id: 08d55af6-d580-4f10-adf7-0d2205d930f0. Basis: the same Wexmoor Lane contract number returned by the rental contract lookup. Uniqueness: it is the only contract the caller asked about and the one shown expired on 2026-09-30.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.renewal_premium: 705.92. Base monthly 64.99 (Rental Combo, one unit). Pay-in-full rate 0.05 (two returned payments, 2024-10-07 and 2025-10-09, in 36 months). Carried portfolio rate 0.05 from the expired term's annual premium charge. Standard premium 12 x 64.99 x 0.95 x 0.95 = 703.8417. Claims-experience loading 0.06: benefit 228.00 + 196.00 + 92.00 = 516.00 in twelve months (the 2025-09-24 authorization of 150.00 is outside), expired-term premium 492.38 + catch-up 37.21 = 529.59; 516.00 is at least half of it but below it, three authorizations. Request-frequency loading 0.05 (four requests in twelve months). Tenure credit 0.04 (purchased 2023-10-01, 1,109 days). Line-plan bundle credit 0.03 (active line plan, eleven payments in twelve months). Adjustment 0.06 + 0.05 - 0.04 - 0.03 = 0.04. Lapse-day credit: notice 2026-08-28 is 33 days before 2026-09-30 (fewer than 45) and auto-renew on, so the actual-day convention applies: 13 lapse days, factor (365 - 13)/365. 703.8417 x 1.04 x 352/365 = 705.92.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.portfolio_discount_rate: 0.05. Basis: late-renewal rule "carries the portfolio discount rate recorded on the expired term's annual premium charge into the new term"; that charge (2025-10-01) records 0.05. Uniqueness: the count of contracts in force is not taken again for a late renewal.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the returned-payment fee tool named by the returned-payment fee policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Bill the returned-payment fee of 20.00 for payment 31570655, which was billed back on 2025-10-09 without its fee.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No Plus upgrade charge is fixed until the most recent returned payment carries its returned-payment fee; the fee waits on the contract standing in force again; the returned-payment fee policy computes the fee.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.landlord_contract_id: 08d55af6-d580-4f10-adf7-0d2205d930f0. Basis: the returned payment charge of 2025-10-09 sits on this contract. Uniqueness: no other contract carries a returned payment.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_reference: 31570655. Basis: the returned payment charge entry of 2025-10-09 names payment 31570655, and no returned-payment fee entry names it (the 2024-10-07 fee names 31570311). Uniqueness: it is the only returned payment on the contract without a fee.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount: 20.00. Repeat-return level 35.00 (exactly two returned payments in 36 months). Fee basis: the returned payment of 492.38 is at least 400.00 and under 1000.00, so the flat basis applies: 35.00 + 5.00 = 40.00. Returned-channel addition 5.00 (payment 31570655 had been made by check). Portfolio courtesy 5.00 (most recent annual premium charge, the new term's, records 0.05). Fee before ageing 40.00 + 5.00 - 5.00 = 40.00. Ageing reduction 0.50 (12 whole months from 2025-10-09 to 2026-10-14). 40.00 x 0.50 = 20.00 (the standard fee would be 25.00).

evaluation_criteria.objective: The landlord accepts the move to Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus at an upgrade charge of 100.45; the tier changes, the prior tier is kept as Rental Combo and the charge is billed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Root problem: the caller's request; the Plus upgrade charge policy computes the charge on the renewed term after the catch-up charge and the returned-payment fee stand on the contract.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.landlord_contract_id: 08d55af6-d580-4f10-adf7-0d2205d930f0. Basis: the Wexmoor Lane contract number from the rental contract lookup, read out to the caller. Uniqueness: the contract she asked to upgrade.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_variant_name: Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus. Basis: the caller asks for "Combo Plus" and the Plus upgrade rule names the move "from Bridgewell Rental Combo to Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus"; the tool lists Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus as the top single-unit tier. Uniqueness: the other values are lower tiers or multi-unit tiers a single-family house does not qualify for.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.upgrade_charge: 100.45. Annual Plus step 12 x (76.99 - 64.99) x 0.90 x 0.95 = 123.12 at the renewed term's rate 0.05. Repeat-change share: one upgrade charge (the catch-up) billed in the last twelve months and no authorization in the last three months (2026-07-03 is three whole months back), so the share is whole months to 2027-10-13 counted down (11) over twelve = 11/12 instead of 364/365. Adjustment 1 - 0.03 (active line plan, eleven payments in twelve months) - 0.03 (most recent premium payment by ACH, no returned payment in twelve months) - 0.05 (upgrade made 0 days after the term start) = 0.89. 123.12 x 11/12 x 0.89 = 100.45.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.portfolio_discount_rate: 0.05. Basis: the Plus upgrade rule uses "the portfolio discount rate recorded on the current term's annual premium charge"; the new term's charge records 0.05. Uniqueness: one annual premium charge in the current term.

edges.condition: The contract status is waiting_period or active, and its term start and term end dates describe a current term for which an annual premium charge stands on the contract.
edges.policy_source: An upgrade charge is worked out only once the contract stands in a current term, in its waiting period or active, whose annual premium is billed on the contract.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Wexmoor Lane contract is not in a current term: its term ended 2026-09-30 and it shows status expired, so there is no current term with an annual premium billed.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The late renewal sets status active, term 2026-10-14 to 2027-10-13 and bills the 705.92 annual premium, so the unexpired days become 364.

edges.condition: The contract's billing entries carry an upgrade proration charge for every tier upgrade the contract records.
edges.policy_source: An upgrade charge is fixed only after every earlier tier upgrade on the contract carries its own upgrade charge.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The contract records a plan change on 2026-05-12 from Rental Systems, but no upgrade proration charge stands in its billing history.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The catch-up write adds an upgrade proration charge of 37.21, so one upgrade charge falls in the twelve months before the Plus upgrade.

edges.condition: The most recent returned payment charge on the contract has a returned-payment fee charge naming the same payment.
edges.policy_source: No upgrade charge is fixed until the most recent returned payment on the contract carries its returned-payment fee.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The fee write adds a returned-payment fee of 20.00 naming 31570655.

edges.condition: The contract's billing entries carry an upgrade proration charge for every tier upgrade recorded during the expired term, so the expired term's premium includes those charges.
edges.policy_source: The late-renewal premium is fixed only after every tier upgrade made during the expired term carries its upgrade charge on the contract.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The upgrade made during the expired term (2026-05-12) carries no upgrade charge, so the expired term's premium is only the 492.38 annual premium.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the catch-up charge of 37.21 is billed, the expired term's premium is 529.59 and the claims-experience loading drops from 0.12 to 0.06.

edges.condition: The contract status is waiting_period, active or suspended_nonpayment when the fee is billed.
edges.policy_source: A returned-payment fee is not billed until the contract stands in force again, in a status under which premium is billed.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The contract stands expired, a status under which premium is not billed.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The late renewal sets the status to active.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The order is fully fixed by the edges, with no free pair: the late-renewal premium waits on the catch-up charge ("The late-renewal premium is fixed only after every tier upgrade made during the expired term carries its upgrade charge on the contract."), the fee waits on the renewal ("A returned-payment fee is not billed until the contract stands in force again, in a status under which premium is billed."), and the Plus upgrade charge waits on all three. Catch-up -> late renewal -> fee -> Plus upgrade is the only topological order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the late renewal leaves the contract expired with term end 2026-09-30: the Plus upgrade charge recomputes to -9.95 instead of 100.45, and the upgrade would be written on a contract not in a current term.

Skipping the catch-up charge leaves no upgrade charge in the last twelve months, so the repeat-change share falls back to 364/365 and the Plus upgrade charge becomes 109.28 instead of 100.45; the catch-up row of 37.21 is also missing.

State gate: skipping the fee leaves returned payment 31570655 without its fee; the upgrade value is unchanged (100.45) but the terminal state lacks the 20.00 fee charge and the premium balance ends 843.58 instead of 863.58, with the upgrade fixed before its gate holds.

Skipping the catch-up charge makes the expired term's premium 492.38; benefit 516.00 is at least that with three authorizations, so the claims-experience loading is 0.12 and the late-renewal premium becomes 746.65 instead of 705.92.

State gate: without the late renewal the contract stays expired and the fee (20.0) would be billed on a contract not in force; the terminal state lacks the renewal (status, term dates, 705.92 premium).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona opens only with the upgrade request ("I'd like to upgrade the rental contract on 4418 Wexmoor Lane to Combo Plus."). It never says the contract lapsed, never mentions the May upgrade charge or the returned-payment fee; each of those appears only as a passive reaction that is triggered by the representative first saying it ("If the representative tells you the contract is no longer in force...", "If the representative tells you that an earlier change to your plan was never billed...", "If the representative mentions a fee connected with a payment that came back..."), and no policy id appears in it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four task tools reads a status, a balance or another charge to refuse: bill_upgrade_catchup_f812c6ed creates the charge and updates the balance whatever the status; record_late_renewal_5b858282 updates the contract and creates the annual premium without checking the grace period; bill_returned_payment_fee_d229d74e creates the fee charge on any contract; accept_plus_upgrade_7955ec7e changes the tier and bills the charge without checking status, fees or earlier upgrade charges. Each body is a find of the contract row for its customer id and dates, then ctx.create / ctx.update and a receipt; none returns an Error.
